description: Land Title Settlement Department - Karamada, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320249 (7711)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific corrections and updates to land parcel information, including owner name amendments, parcel number corrections, location name changes, and servitude rights modifications for various land parcels across different districts. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land title registrations, property ownership details, and cadastral map amendments.
